title: Recipe: kingfisher fish supper

scenes.headline: Wait on a perch over the water
scenes.body: Anywhere from a few centimetres to a few metres up.

scenes.headline: No perch? Hover, then plunge
scenes.body: Pied kingfishers often hover before diving.

scenes.headline: Whack the fish on the branch
scenes.body: It stuns the fish — handy for spiny ones. Then swallow.

scenes.label: of its body weight eaten every day

caption:
A three-step recipe with zero cooking.

Afterwards, kingfishers cough up a pellet of the fish bones they can't digest.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Alcedo atthis, Ceryle rudis). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Overhead-recipe structure (ingredient, steps, portion) mapped onto real hunting behaviour of two kingfisher species, each labelled correctly.
